summary: Iteration 44 — SSID Bridge (Tampermonkey WS interceptor + backend POST /api/po/ssid/update / status / connect + SSIDStatusWidget on dashboard). 14/14 backend pytest cases passed. Frontend: widget renders both CONNECTED state (badge, uid 98765 · DEMO, verify+refresh buttons, last-seen, expires-in) and NO SSID state (badge 'NO SSID' + ssid-instructions block mentioning Tampermonkey) end-to-end after login as triddick84. Tampermonkey modular bundle v8.10.0 served 200, includes @run-at document-start and markers 'SSID-Bridge' (8x), 'po/ssid/update' (1x), 'eliteBotSsidBridge' (1x). Mongo collection po_ssid_state has exactly one _id='current' doc after update; po_ssid_history mirrors audit entries. Status endpoint never exposes raw session/auth_message.

minor.issue: When pocketoptionapi_async.client.connect() returns False (fake/invalid session, no exception), response body lacks the 'error' field — returns {success:false, connected:false, balance:null, uid, is_demo, session_preview}. Problem statement expects {success:false, connected:false, error:...}. Only the except-branch includes 'error'. Minor contract mismatch — frontend widget falls back to 'Connection failed' string, so UX still works, but the documented API shape is not honored for non-exception failure.

action_items: Non-blocking: add 'error' field (e.g., 'WS connect returned False') in the post-connect branch of /po/ssid/connect when connected=False, so the contract {success, connected, error} is consistent whether or not an exception was raised.
critical_code_review_comments: _parse_auth_message correctly validates prefix '42["auth"', extracts session/uid/isDemo/platform via regex, and raises ValueError that surfaces as HTTP 400 with the exact expected detail string.
Idempotent heartbeat in /po/ssid/update is correct — same session → last_seen_at bumped without re-inserting; new session → upsert + history row.
/po/ssid/status strips {_id, auth_message, session} via projection, so raw SSID cannot leak. Health classifier handles expired/expiring (<600s)/stale (age>300s)/healthy buckets.
Mongo _id='current' pattern keeps po_ssid_state collection single-row by design; verified via test_po_ssid_state_single_doc.
po_ssid_history index is created on every call (try/except). Consider moving create_index to startup hook to avoid repeated create calls on every SSID update.
SSIDStatusWidget polls every 15s via setInterval and cleans up on unmount — correct. Refresh and verify buttons are guarded with loading/verifying flags.
Widget correctly hides uid/verify/last-seen/expires-in when has_ssid=false and shows ssid-instructions prompt pointing to Tampermonkey — matches spec.
Minor: /po/ssid/connect path has no 'error' key in the non-exception failure branch (see minor backend issue).

Tampermonkey bundle v8.10.0 served from /pocket-option-auto-trader-modular.user.js with @run-at document-start (so WS interceptor installs before page scripts hook WebSocket); contains minified markers 'SSID-Bridge', 'po/ssid/update', 'eliteBotSsidBridge'.
seed_data_creation: Test-only SSID entries (TESTsessionA..., TESTsessionB..., and UI-seed TESTsessionUIwidget12345678 with uid=98765) inserted and cleaned at module teardown. At the very end of the run, po_ssid_state was deleted so the app starts fresh.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SSID Bridge endpoints live at /api/po/ssid/{update,status,connect} in /app/backend/routes/pocket_option.py (lines 2760-2994). PoSsidBridgePayload pydantic model takes auth_message (required), source (default 'tampermonkey'), ua (optional). Parser requires prefix '42["auth"'.
